PROXY_PROBE_MM.rule: R0, R1: ρ — the probe; an opening narrower than 2ρ bridged

PROXY_FACE_MIN_MM.rule: R3: w — no face the gizmo travels narrower

PROXY_FLUSH_MM.rule: R2, R6: a planar proxy face ON its real face

PROXY_CURVE_TOL_MM.rule: R2, R4: τ — a curve's facet (its sagitta recorded beside it)

COLLISION_TOL_MM.rule: C-R2: τc — the collision pieces true to the part

B1_FIT_MM.rule: B1e, R6, D4: the proxy ON its collision pieces

UCX_MAX_VERTICES.rule: C-R1, B1d: a collision piece's vertices

UCX_MAX_TRIANGLES.rule: C-R1, B1d: a collision piece's triangles

R7_PLANAR_DEG.rule: R7: one node one planar face

B6_APART_DEG.rule: R4, B6: neighbouring faces one face or this far apart

B6_ELEVATION_BAND_DEG.rule: R4, B6: no face within this of 45° of elevation at its goal

R4_HALF_STEP_DEG.rule: R4, C-R3: a curve's facet (a hexagon's half step); a ring's

COVER_STEP_MM.rule: R1: the voxel step of the ρ-closing (ρ / 2)

R1B_DEEP_DEG.rule: R1b: a point's sky under this — deeper than its mouth is wide (capped)

R1B_AMBER_DEG.rule: R1b: the amber band's top (atan ½)

CLOSED_STEP_MM.rule: R2: an edge read every this (closed)

COLLISION_SAMPLE_MM.rule: C-R2: the render sampled at this spacing

RESTING_MIN_SHARE.rule: decision 5: a resting candidate ≥ this of the largest (decided 2026-11-24)

B6_SIZE_MARGIN_MM.rule: B6: a face at a threshold — the piece fits or is held out by less than this (⏳ PROPOSED)

B6_SHARE_MARGIN.rule: B6: a facet near the face map's share, within this of it (⏳ PROPOSED)
